module.name: no-identical-expressions
module.description: Find likely copy-and-paste mistakes in comparisons and logical expressions.

scenarios.name: should allow comparisons of separate regular expression objects

scenarios.when: the rule analyzes the fixture with default options

scenarios.given: const doubled = text + text; const difference = next() - next();

scenarios.when: the rule analyzes the fixture with default options

scenarios.given: const same = value /* left */ === /* right */ value;
scenarios.when: the rule analyzes the fixture with default options
scenarios.then: the expected diagnostic is reported: [{ messageId: 'identicalExpressions' }]
